description: This PHP source file implements an interface for interacting with Redmine issue trackers, including functionalities for testing connectivity, retrieving issues, and creating new issues. It also contains configuration setup and test cases with multiple user roles and project types.

classes.name: redminerestInterface
classes.description: A class encapsulating interactions with a Redmine issue tracker via REST API, including methods to connect, retrieve, and create issues.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class managing issue tracker configurations and interactions, instantiated with a database connection.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the interface has an active connection to the Redmine server.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue by ID from the Redmine server.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in the Redmine server with specified subject and description.
